scene_type: 2D (top-down view of a table; treat as planar, one px scale)
time_convention: t = frame / fps; frame = round(t * fps)
units: pixels (full resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
description: Overhead (near top-down) handheld shot of a pepperoni pizza on a square brown-paper/cardboard sheet on a wooden table. A person's right hand (white sweater sleeve, bracelet) pushes a black-handled pizza cutter in one diagonal stroke from the upper-left of the pizza toward the lower-right, stops near the lower-right rim, then lifts the cutter up toward the camera and moves it right. A second person's two hands hold the bottom edge of the pizza board (static). Props: red wine glass (left), Monopoly board, cards and paper money (right).

camera.file: camera.csv (per-frame similarity transform frame i -> frame 0, plus shift of image centre)
camera.summary: content shifts up ~60 px over the clip (image-centre point of frame 0 appears at dy=-61 px at frame 21, -60 px at frame 36), dx within -14..+5 px, rotation up to -0.87 deg, scale change <= 0.9% (slight zoom-in/approach at end). Use x_s0,y_s0 columns (stabilised to frame-0 coordinates) for motion.
camera.perspective: near top-down; pizza appears as ellipse 1015 x 964 px (horizontal wider), i.e. ~5% foreshortening vertically or a slightly non-round pizza. No horizon/vanishing points visible.
